pairs.why: Both are almost the same smooth, glossy toy taxi on a purple dusk road; neither has the real cards' extra built detail or livelier painted finish.
The two taxis differ only in framing and road markings, and they share the same rendering, colour and finish.
B adds a slatted front grille, so the car reads a little more like a built object, the way the preferred saddles did; the rendering is otherwise identical.
A has the slatted grille while B's front is a blank dark panel, which makes A slightly more built like a real car; the finish is the same.
B has a grille and a more detailed roof sign, so it is slightly more built than A's plain front; both have the same toy-like gloss.
A has the grille and the detailed roof sign while B's front is plain, so A is slightly more built; the finish is identical.
The two taxis are practically identical in shape, light and finish.
The two taxis are practically identical, with only small framing differences.
